status: Fresh live binding census plus offline original EXE analysis. No discovered SDK function called, no process attach or game writes.
findings: Camera-shake link callbacks manage a per-camera list consumed for device rumble motor writes, not authored view/look input
Unlink callback is not an evidenced inverse: it calls same append helper in this original captured build
Dead-zone API changes actual axis threshold/remap config; it does not expose native FPS temporal filter, lens ratio or scoped gain
No filter/smoothing/sensitivity setter name exists in the bounded live Input and Mouse tables; Input.event_queue is the only function on Input
limitations: Callback binding presence is live-observed; helper bytes and semantics are from older same-build mapped capture, not a new live byte reread
No SDK functions were invoked or their visible behavior tested
REA raw slice supplies exact callback assembly only; external helper/IAT signatures remain unresolved and its generic calling convention inference is not accepted
Original unlink behavior may be a shipped bug or capture-specific fact; no claim across builds
No complete producer/consumer proof that gameplay look uses Mouse.axis default dead-zone configuration; native FPS temporal filter remains separate evidence
Negative API-name search is limited to completed bounded census, not all possible native engine internals
